description: Finds restaurants listed in the Yemekhost directory, near a position, in a city or district, or by name, dish or cuisine. Results are restaurant branches with their opening state, rating, distance when a position was given, and whether they deliver to it. Orders are not placed here: every result carries an orderUrl, the restaurant's own page, where the person places the order.

cuisine.description: A cuisine name as list_cuisines returns it.

delivery.description: Only branches that deliver to the position.

district.description: Only branches in this district; give the city with it.

group_by_brand.description: One result per brand, the nearest branch. Default true.

latitude.description: Latitude of the position, in degrees. Give it together with longitude.

longitude.description: Longitude of the position, in degrees. Give it together with latitude.

open_now.description: Only branches that are taking orders now.

query.description: A restaurant, a dish or a product to look for.

radius_metres.description: Search radius around the position, in metres. Default 5000, at most 30000.

size.description: Results per page. Default 20, at most 100.

name: search_restaurants
title: Search restaurants
